title: Normalized coefficient fibers give a vanishing error tower
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $O$, and a scheme $T$. Put $R=\mathcal O_{E,T}$ and $B_n=(O/\ell^n)_T$ [sk-def-sp-coefficient-towers]. Let $Q_n$ be K-flat complexes of $B_n$-modules [def-pc-kflat-complex] with strict semilinear chain transitions $q_{n,m}:Q_n\to Q_m$ for $1\leq m\leq n$, satisfying identities and the cocycle law. Assume every actual reduction map $Q_n\otimes_{B_n}B_m\to Q_m$, $x\otimes b\mapsto bq_{n,m}(x)$, is a quasi-isomorphism. No boundedness or constructibility is assumed.

Fix $m\geq1$ and, for $n\geq m$, put $K_m=[R\xrightarrow{\ell^m}R]$ in degrees $[-1,0]$, $P_{n,m}=B_n\otimes_RK_m$, $F_{n,m}=\operatorname{Cone}(P_{n,m}\to B_m)[-1]$, and $S_n=Q_n\otimes_{B_n}B_m$, using the coefficient augmentation and total tensor convention of [lem-sp-ell-coefficient-fiber, def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves]. There is a distinguished triangle of strict $R$-towers on $n\geq m$ whose terms are $Q_n\otimes_{B_n}F_{n,m}$, $Q_n\otimes_RK_m$, and $S_n$. Its right arrow is the coefficient augmentation, with the middle identification induced by $x\otimes(b\otimes k)\mapsto bx\otimes k$. The left tower is quasi-isomorphic to the tower $S_n[1]$ with transition from $n'$ to $n$ equal to $\ell^{n'-n}$ times the usual transition on $S$. The maps $S_n\to Q_m$ above form a strict levelwise quasi-isomorphism to the constant tower on $Q_m$.

For total derived inverse limits of strict towers [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-strict-tower-homotopy-limit], the left tower has zero limit and the composite
$$R\!\lim_{n\geq m}(Q_n\otimes_RK_m)\longrightarrow R\!\lim_{n\geq m}S_n\longrightarrow Q_m$$
is an isomorphism in $D(R)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. The last arrow is induced by the displayed strict map to the constant tower, using its diagonal identification with $Q_m$. Thus this composite is the one induced by the original transition maps and coefficient augmentations.

proof.text: Apply the normalized strict tensor-fiber theorem, obtaining the chain-level towers, maps, their formulas, distinguished triangle, powered-shift quasi-isomorphism, normalized strict reduction, and eventual zero powered transitions. Induction on the gap computes the exact powered transition formula.

Apply the ringed strict-tower limit theorem and transport its K-injective computation, exact structure, and pro-zero criterion to the specified total right-derived functor by the unique derived-functor isomorphism. Naturality of the evaluation comparison transports evaluated transitions without changing them.
Naturality of the levelwise quasi-isomorphism from the powered shift implies its eventually zero transitions make A pro-zero after localization. Apply the transported pro-zero criterion.

Evaluation at zero is exact and left adjoint to constants: the adjunct of f:X_0→P has component X_n→X_0→P. Constants therefore preserve K-injectives. Resolve Q_m by a K-injective complex; the ordinary constant/limit unit is invertible since constants are fully faithful. The derived comparison on the constant resolution is invertible. Naturality and the resolution quasi-isomorphism prove that the specified diagonal is invertible.

Exact evaluation detects that the normalized strict reduction is a quasi-isomorphism. Apply the exact derived limit to the strict distinguished triangle. Since its first object is zero, its second arrow is invertible by the distinguished-triangle zero-object criterion. Compose with the localized strict reduction and inverse of the actual diagonal.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-Q100-023d7abda (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: I read the item and all its cited statements in full. The statement and stmt_deps are unchanged from the side-live base. The delivery has 7 steps of at most 1161 characters each and creates no new nodes. The item is still unsplit in live and side-live, so it is not superseded. It has no re-split note of its own (the only note is for sk-lem-sp-tower), it is not on the dropped list, and no SGA source is cited. The route matches the sk-lem-sp-tower blueprint proof paragraph (coefficient-fiber triangle, normalization, left term killed along m-steps, vanishing Rlim, reduction formula) and Bhatt–Scholze Lemma 3.5.4 for the regular element ℓ. Stacks 08BJ, 0940 and 0941 exist with matching labels. Step checks: (1) the balanced semilinear transitions and the associativity identification are correct, and no differential sign is needed because B_n sits in degree 0. (2) The φ_L summand formulas (id and (-1)^p) commute with the varying-ring transitions, so the tensored triangle is the rotated cone triangle of a in Ch(Tow), which is distinguished. (3) I checked the shift sign (-1)^p against the -d_S differential. The chain-level identity red(ℓ^{n'-m}b)=ℓ^{n-m}ℓ^{n'-n}b gives a strict quasi-isomorphism E→A, and K-flatness of Q_n over B_n is used exactly here. (4) ρ is balanced and the cocycle law makes it a strict quasi-isomorphism to ΔQ_m. (5) ℓ^m kills S_n, so e_{n+m,n}=0 and the transition of A is conjugate to it, hence 0 in D(R). After reindexing, the pro-zero clause of the strict-tower node applies. Its small-site hypothesis comes from def-weil-size-convention, as for every other pro-étale user of that node. (6) ev_m ⊣ Δ shows ΔI is K-injective, the limit of ΔI is I, and the diagonal is represented by i. lem-sbc-unbounded-exact-adjunction-square(1) states the same off-unit, so inlining it as an elementary step is fine. (7) Hom-exactness gives ur=1 and ru=1, so the composite is exactly the one in the statement. Edge cases tested: m=1, n=m, n'=n, gap exactly m, and Q_n=B_n (giving Rlim[B_n→ℓ^m B_n]≃B_m), plus unbounded complexes. I accept the five declared tool uses: the tensor-cone, strict-tower Rlim and K-injective-existence nodes are generic, and the other two are Mathlib leaves. No fixes.
